verdict.rationale: Expensify's own features support same-day spend visibility in part: SmartScan extracts receipt data in realtime, it reads the merchant, it auto-categorizes expenses as they are created, and Ask Expensify AI returns answers and charts on spend. However, nothing documents a live spend dashboard broken down by team, category, and merchant, or real-time card transaction feeds. Community reports of slow receipt processing and frequent miscategorization weaken confidence in that freshness and accuracy. Missing for 10: documented real-time spend dashboard, breakdowns by team/department, merchant-level spend reporting, evidence that card transactions appear the same day, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land

citations.quote: Get instant answers and charts for anything in your account, from monthly spend to a full quarterly flux analysis
SmartScan extracts receipt data in realtime, with no batch processing or overnight delays.
Expensify uses your policies and past behavior to auto-categorize expenses as they're created.
SmartScan reads the merchant, date, total, and currency automatically.
